units.source_text: 小皇子日渐长大，相貌越发肖似源氏公子，竟难于分辨。

en.t: As the young prince grew day by day, his features came to resemble Prince Genji more and more, until it was hard to tell them apart.

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子看了心中非常痛苦。

en.t: When Lady Fujitsubo saw this, she felt deep anguish in her heart.

units.source_text: 然而别人并不注意及此。

en.t: Yet no one else paid any attention to it.

units.source_text: 世人都以为：无论何人，无论怎样改头换面，都赶不上源氏公子的美貌。

en.t: People all believed that no matter who it was, and no matter how they altered their appearance, they could never match Prince Genji's beauty.

units.source_text: 而小皇子当然肖似源氏公子，正像日月行空，光辉自然相似。

en.t: So of course the young prince resembled Prince Genji, just as the sun and moon crossing the sky naturally share a similar radiance.
